description: This file implements a class for token counting for Vertex AI Partner Models, specifically handling models such as Claude, Mistral, and others. It includes methods for determining the publisher based on model name, building API endpoints, and handling asynchronous token count requests.

classes.name: VertexAIPartnerModelsTokenCounter
